usageNotes: Use this to update cluster-wide datacenter settings such as migration policy, HA behavior, bandwidth limits, console type, and WebAuthn/U2F configuration. Requires `Sys.Modify` on `/` (root path), so only cluster administrators can call it. The operation returns null synchronously — changes take effect immediately with no task UPID to poll; use `delete` param to unset individual settings rather than omitting them.

examples.summary: Set migration to insecure on a private network, cap migration bandwidth to 500 MiB/s, and switch console to xtermjs

tips: Use the `delete` param (comma-separated config key names) to remove a setting back to its default rather than setting it to an empty string.
Changing `webauthn` id or origin will invalidate existing hardware key registrations for all users.
`mac_prefix` only affects auto-generated MACs for new guests; existing VMs keep their current MAC.
The `notify` field sub-keys are largely deprecated in favor of the datacenter notification targets UI — check PVE release notes before relying on them.
`fencing` modes `hardware` and `both` are marked EXPERIMENTAL — only use `watchdog` in production unless you have tested fence devices configured.
